page_title: KubeSwitch - Kubernetes Switch Namespace Mac App

sources.entry: KubeSwitch - The fastest way to switch between Kubernetes contexts and namespaces on macOS. ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: KubeSwitch
summary.one_liner: A native macOS menu bar app for quickly switching Kubernetes contexts and namespaces with a global hotkey and fuzzy search.
use_cases: Switching between Kubernetes clusters quickly on a Mac
Changing the active namespace without typing kubectl commands
Checking the current Kubernetes context from the menu bar
Working across EKS, GKE, AKS or OpenShift clusters from one tool
summary.what_it_does: KubeSwitch is a macOS app for switching between Kubernetes contexts and namespaces. A global hotkey opens a QuickSwitch panel, where a user types a few characters to fuzzy-search across all contexts and namespaces. It lives in the macOS menu bar and shows the current context without opening a window. It automatically detects and merges multiple kubeconfig files and watches them in real time for updates. The page says it works with any cluster reachable by kubectl, including EKS, GKE, AKS, OpenShift and self-hosted, and that config data and credentials stay local with no telemetry.
notable: Global hotkey QuickSwitch with fuzzy search across contexts and namespaces
Menu bar display of current context
Automatic merging and real-time watching of multiple kubeconfig files
100% local processing with zero telemetry, per the page
caveats: Paid product: one-time lifetime license, price amount not stated in the page text
